qualifier: fibroblast migration, survival and matrix assembly
name: Fibroblast behaviour and matrix assembly in fibrotic repair
rationale: Members regulate fibroblast migration, apoptosis and myofibroblast differentiation, collagen and ECM assembly and connective tissue replacement, unlike confusables centred on cardiomyocytes, miRNA processing, ECM disassembly or core TGF-beta/SMAD signalling.

name: Carnitine and choline metabolism with organic ion transport
rationale: Members cover carnitine synthesis and SLC22A5 deficiency, choline metabolism and SLC organic cation/anion and dicarboxylate transport, whereas confusables emphasise lactate/monocarboxylate, malate-aspartate shuttle and TCA intermediate transport.

name: GDNF-RET and endothelin signalling in enteric nervous system development
rationale: Members combine RET/GDNF and endothelin receptor signalling with enteric neural crest migration, midgut development and peristalsis, unlike confusables about catecholaminergic sympathetic development or gastrointestinal smooth muscle and gastric function.

name: Stalled ribosome rescue in no-go and non-stop mRNA decay
rationale: Members concern rescue and dissociation of stalled ribosomes (PELO:HBS1L/ABCE1) and no-go mRNA decay, distinct from nonsense-mediated decay, translation initiation and RQC/stress granule confusables.

qualifier: plasma membrane reuptake transporters and vesicular loading
name: Norepinephrine and dopamine transporter reuptake with vesicular loading
rationale: Members cover norepinephrine/dopamine transporter (SLC6A2/SLC6A3) uptake and their defects plus synaptic vesicle loading and acidification, while confusables add generic monoamine transport, catecholamine synthesis or degradation.

name: Telomerase-mediated telomere extension in replicative lifespan
rationale: Members centre on telomerase holoenzyme assembly and telomere lengthening tied to replicative senescence, growth rate and lifespan, unlike confusables about Cajal body trafficking, telomere capping/recombination or C-strand synthesis.

name: Left-right asymmetry determination via nodal signalling
rationale: All members specify left-right asymmetry of organs and lateral mesoderm, including nodal regulation and nodal cilia, distinct from motile cilium assembly, gastrulation and extracellular ligand sequestration confusables.

qualifier: nucleic-acid sensing and type I interferon induction
name: Nucleic-acid sensing and type I interferon antiviral response
rationale: Members span endosomal TLR7/8/9/3, RIG-I/MDA5, cGAS-STING and AIM2 sensing driving type I/III interferon and ISG responses, broader than confusables restricted to host viral restriction, IFN-alpha signatures or TRIF/TAK1 signalling.

qualifier: alpha/beta-oxidation, elongation and ether lipid synthesis
name: Peroxisomal fatty acid oxidation, elongation and ether lipid synthesis
rationale: Members cover very long-chain and branched fatty acid alpha/beta-oxidation, elongation, plasmalogen and wax synthesis and ABCD1 defects, unlike confusables on omega-oxidation, malonyl/succinyl-CoA or cholesterol synthesis.

name: MHC class I antigen processing and cross-presentation
rationale: Members describe peptide loading onto MHC class I for endogenous antigens and phagosomal/endosomal cross-presentation, unlike confusables on MHC class II presentation, proteasome assembly or viral Nef downregulation.

name: Chemokine-directed dendritic cell and NK cell chemotaxis
rationale: Members cover chemokine-receptor binding and CCR7-driven migration of dendritic and NK cells plus mature cDC differentiation, whereas confusables emphasise monocyte differentiation, T/B cell homing or integrin adhesion.

qualifier: autoprocessing and release in head morphogenesis
name: Hedgehog ligand autoprocessing and secretion in head morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern Hh precursor self-proteolysis, palmitoylation defects, ERAD and release alongside head, neurocranium and diaphragm morphogenesis, unlike confusables on SMO/GLI signal transduction, Wnt or Notch processing.

name: Endothelial shear stress mechanotransduction and SRF actin targets
rationale: Members cover laminar and oscillatory shear stress signalling via PIEZO1 in endothelium with SRF-driven actin cytoskeleton modules, unlike confusables on eNOS trafficking or vascular smooth muscle phenotype.

qualifier: salivary gland branching and limb bud
name: Epithelial-mesenchymal signalling in salivary branching and limb bud
rationale: Members share reciprocal epithelial-mesenchymal signalling controlling salivary gland branching, mesenchymal proliferation and limb bud formation, distinct from pancreas, prostate, lung mesenchyme and other gland development confusables.

name: Metanephric glomerular mesangium and tubule segment development
rationale: Members cover development of glomerular mesangium and endothelium and proximal, distal, loop of Henle and collecting duct segments plus filtration, unlike confusables on early nephrogenesis/ureteric bud or podocyte and basement membrane.

name: Fructose and alditol metabolism with inherited fructose disorders
rationale: Members cover fructose catabolism, polyol (alditol) synthesis and breakdown, and essential fructosuria and hereditary fructose intolerance, unlike confusables on gluconeogenesis, glycolysis, glycerol or pentose metabolism.

qualifier: mRNA capping and evasion of host restriction
name: Viral RNA capping, translation and evasion of host restriction
rationale: Members combine viral genome replication and mRNA translation with capping, PKR inhibition, IFIT evasion and host mRNA processing inhibition, unlike confusables on coronavirus replicase maturation or influenza/RSV RNP synthesis.

name: Glycerophospholipid biosynthesis and acyl-chain remodelling
rationale: Members cover synthesis and acyl-chain remodelling of PC, PE, PS, PI, PG and cardiolipin, distinct from confusables on lysophospholipid hydrolysis, endocannabinoids or sphingolipid metabolism.

qualifier: mitotic nuclear envelope disassembly and reassembly
name: Nuclear pore complex and mitotic nuclear envelope remodelling
rationale: Members concern NPC assembly, nucleocytoplasmic transport of inositol phosphates, ribosomal subunits and Rev, and mitotic envelope breakdown and ESCRT-III resealing, unlike confusables on chromosome condensation, mRNA export or SUMOylation.

name: Type I interferon response and its negative regulation
rationale: Members cover IFN-alpha/beta responses and IRF3 induction together with negative regulation of IFN-beta production, type I IFN signalling and cGAS-STING (TREX1), unlike confusables on ISG signatures, TLR7/9 or RIG-I sensing.

name: Synaptic vesicle docking, priming, fusion and recycling
rationale: Members cover synaptic vesicle docking, priming, SNARE assembly, fusion, endocytic recycling and neurotransmitter release cycles, unlike confusables on presynaptic modulation of exocytosis or postsynaptic receptor trafficking.

name: Two-pore domain potassium channels setting resting membrane potential
rationale: Members are TREK, TWIK, THIK, TRESK and TASK K2P channels and resting potential regulation, unlike confusables on voltage-gated and Kir channels, TALK/sour taste or pain perception.

qualifier: type III and alpha interferon with chemokine induction
name: Interferon-lambda and -alpha responses with antiviral chemokine induction
rationale: Members cover type III interferon production and response, IFN-alpha response and CCL5/CXCL10 chemokine induction, distinct from confusables dominated by RIG-I/TLR sensing, ISG15 or GBP host defence.

name: Lysosomal glycosaminoglycan and glycoconjugate catabolism
rationale: Members cover lysosomal degradation of heparan, chondroitin/dermatan and keratan sulfate, gangliosides, oligosaccharides and sialic acid with mucopolysaccharidoses, unlike confusables on GAG biosynthesis, glycosylation or sialic acid synthesis.

name: Phenylalanine and tyrosine catabolism
rationale: All members concern phenylalanine and tyrosine metabolism and degradation including phenylketonuria, unlike confusables on glycine, histidine or threonine catabolism.
